About

The story behind the story.

"Breaking down the world, one story at a time."

Kumar Vishal makes sense of what's actually happening — in politics, in society, and in the events that quietly reshape everyday life. No shouting matches, no borrowed outrage, no agenda to sell. Just the facts, laid out plainly, in the language most of the audience actually thinks in.

Every video is built the same way: take a headline everyone's arguing about, strip away the noise, and explain what's really going on — who's involved, what's at stake, and why it matters to you.

Plain language, straight explanations. Politics and society, explained the way you'd explain it to a friend.
